data.text:
A Quezon City Regional Trial Court has convicted a Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) member for leading a blockade during protests tied to the arrest of Pastor Apollo Quiboloy.

Eduardo Corda was among those who attempted to clog the Philippine-Japan Friendship Highway in Davao City by staging a “prayer rally” while police operations were ongoing.
